title: Surreal Red Ferrari Dreamscape
description: A vibrant red Ferrari 296 GTB with white racing stripes and the number 07 sits centrally in a surreal, dark environment. The car is surrounded by floating green orbs, geometric blue and yellow crystal shards, flowering vines, and a large stylized woman's face composed of colorful geometric facets in the background.
prompt: A striking red Ferrari 296 GTB with white racing stripes and number 07 positioned in the center of a dark surreal dreamscape. The car is intertwined with flowering green vines and surrounded by floating luminous green orbs. To the right, a large stylized female face made of vibrant blue, yellow, and purple geometric facets emerges from the darkness. The ground consists of sharp angular blue, purple and yellow crystal shards. Wind chimes hang in the shadowy background, creating a mystical and ethereal atmosphere.
